name: 妙喜庵待庵
checkpoints: Small single-storey tearoom under a plain gabled kokera wood-shingle roof, with narrow attached bamboo-supported lean-to eave.
Two-tatami tea chamber scale: low nijiriguchi entry and lattice windows, ochre mud walls and exposed dark timber. Preserve visible actual openings; do not add a temple porch.
Only the tearoom body; omit foreground viewing veranda posts/roof, plants, surrounding garden and neighboring building.
